occupied.description: Occupied: amber-50 bg, amber-400 border, amber-900 text, Occupied badge, started-at time and the Preview / Print footer with an amber-200 divider.

reserved.description: Available but locked by a confirmed reservation: primary-50 bg, primary-400 border, Reserved badge and the Reserved for strip.

occupied-reserved.description: Occupied table that also has a lock-window reservation: occupied colours with both the Occupied and Reserved badges and the strip.

take-away.description: Take-away table: pending Take away badge under the seats row.

merged.description: Member of a merged group: the With T6 + T7 line in primary-700 above the rows.

shape-rectangle.description: Rectangle shape icon (table_shape Rectangle, also the fallback).

menu-available.description: Actions menu open on an available table: card lifted to z-20 with the Reserve and Merge tables popover.

menu-occupied.description: Actions menu open on an occupied table: Merge tables, Transfer table and Transfer captain.

printing.description: Print in progress: spinner and Printing... label, button dimmed to 60%.

hover-available.description: Hover on an available card: emerald-400 border and shadow-md.

hover-reserved.description: Hover on a reserved card: primary-500 border and shadow-md.

hover-footer-button.description: Hover on the Preview button of an occupied card: amber-100 background.

disabled.reason: no disabled control: the only disabled state is the Printing button, shown as a variant

error.reason: the tables page error state (red alert icon and message) is a separate full-page state, not part of this component

loading.reason: spinner placeholders are shown as the printing variant where the source animates

empty.reason: the no-tables state is a page state and is not part of this component
